items.title: Lionel Hampton interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995
items.q: The interviewee only confirms the interviewer's statement that Dewey Redman is Josh Redman's father ('Yeah?') and does not describe any personal interaction or relationship with Dewey Redman himself.

ctx.x: The guy that’s playing the tenor part on there, it goes on the jacket there that he plays the tenor part, naturally will become very famous. It’s a guy by the name of Josh Redman. And he’s a guy that’s making a whole lot of noise now with his saxophone playing. And he’s playing on this. I’d like to say that that’s one of the finest saxophone solos I’ve heard.
He comes from a line of saxophone players doesn’t he. His father, Josh? His father is Dewey Redman, right?
